heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: DECISION 1: While we acknowledge potential benefits from AI applications in the school system:

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: We see a lesser and less immediate need to develop policy to accelerate and promote GenAI adoption in the schools.

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: We see a greater and more immediate need to develop policy to protect learning by restricting certain GenAI applications in the schools.

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: Pragmatic Constraints on Restriction of GenAI Applications

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: We acknowledge limits on our ability to fully enforce GenAI restrictions when work is un-proctored

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: We pursue opportunities to move summative assessments into a proctored environment, but acknowledge constraints.

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: We value maintaining positive and trusting rapport between students and teachers

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: We are motivated to protect students from patently unfair outcomes:

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: False accusations of cheating

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: Competing with peers who are in rampant non-compliance with GenAI restrictions

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: DECISION 2: So we steer between two extremes:

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: Abandoning our idealized goals due to pragmatic constraints leads to race-to-the-bottom conditions. Students lose the freedom not to use GenAI.

heading_path: Idealized Goals for Regulating GenAI in FC Schools:
sections.text: Pursuing our idealized restrictions, at all costs, creates a climate of mistrust and fear that is its own impediment to learning
